blocks.text: Subscription billing platform for scaling SaaS businesses

Chargebee specializes in the complexity that subscription businesses face as they scale. Simple recurring billing is easy; managing upgrades, downgrades, prorations, trials, add-ons, usage-based components, and multi-currency pricing across thousands of subscribers is hard. Chargebee handles this complexity.

For SaaS companies outgrowing Stripe Billing, Chargebee offers more granular control over the subscription lifecycle. Experiment with pricing models, manage complex plan hierarchies, and handle enterprise billing scenarios (annual contracts, custom plans, prepaid credits) without custom development.

The retention and dunning features directly impact revenue. Automated payment retry logic, smart dunning emails, and cancellation flow optimization recover revenue that would otherwise be lost to failed payments and voluntary churn.
Complex plan hierarchies, trials, add-ons, and prorations
ASC 606 compliant revenue recognition and deferred revenue
Automated payment retry and recovery for failed transactions
Price in local currencies with automatic conversion
Global tax calculation and filing across jurisdictions
MRR, churn, LTV, and subscription analytics dashboards

When subscription billing gets complex - multiple plan tiers, usage components, enterprise contracts, global tax - Chargebee provides the infrastructure that Stripe Billing alone cannot. It is the billing platform you grow into.
Our team can integrate Chargebee into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
